description.message: Connects Paddock Live to F1 TV: sign in on formula1.com in your browser and the desktop app receives the connection automatically.

appLinked.message: GPS and telemetry enabled (F1 TV connection received)

appUnlinked.message: Not connected to F1 TV yet

send.message: Send my connection to Paddock Live

sent.message: Connection sent: GPS and telemetry enabled.

auto.message: After that, nothing to do: every time you sign in on formula1.com, Paddock Live is notified automatically.

privacy.message: Your F1 TV connection never leaves your computer: it is only sent to the Paddock Live app (127.0.0.1).
